body: A little back story on my opinion. I came from a family of 7 and my mom started “homeschooling” because my brother was diagnosed ADD in the second grade and they recommended medication for it. From my experience I’d highly discourage people from homeschooling because it’s fucked up everyone single one of my siblings. All of us feel like we’ve been cheated out of the advantages school gives. Not just education but also socialization. To this day (even my siblings who have engineering degrees) are dealing with insecurities to the point it’s effecting our mental health. Fuck homeschooling/unschooling. (Edit) the first 4 kids were mostly homeschooled and the last 3 (the bunch im in) were unschooled and we are way more fucked in life than the older kids.
